description: Games Master paid flash mint: prepare (unsigned) one transaction buying `quantity` (1 to 20) from the flash sale that is open right now, for exactly price x quantity in ETH (read live). `product` is crate, portal or mercenary (optional: the open sale is used); mercenaries also need `mercType` 0 Shinobi, 1 Operator, 2 Breacher, 3 Ghost, 4 Marksman. Refused when no event is live, the cap is sold out, the input is bad or the wallet cannot afford it. The wallet is simulated. You sign and send it yourself, before the event ends.

product.description: Optional: which flash sale. Omit to use whichever is open.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and pick rights, and to simulate.

name: prepare_gm_flash_mint
